data.notes: Confirmed April 2027 inventory is still early: Miami’s club/festival calendar is sparse, while Pride, select concerts, and PortMiami music cruises are already on sale or announced.

events.title: Miami Beach Pride Festival
events.summary: Miami Beach Pride’s two-day festival and parade weekend returns to Lummus Park and Ocean Drive with the organizer promoting world-class entertainment as part of the 2027 celebration.

events.title: Cruise to the Edge 2027
events.summary: Progressive rock and metal festival cruise departing Miami aboard Norwegian Jewel, with announced artists including Marillion, Steve Hackett, Big Big Train, Symphony X, Adrian Belew, Haken and Queensrÿche.

events.title: UNSIN 2027
events.venueName: Miami, FL (exact address released after registration)
events.summary: UNSIN returns as a two-day Latin music conference and festival built around panels, workshops, live showcases and networking for Latin artists, founders, executives and creators.

events.title: Little Steven’s Underground Garage Cruise
events.venueName: Norwegian Jewel, Miami to Puerto Plata
events.summary: The third Underground Garage Cruise sails round-trip from Miami with a punk/garage-rock lineup including The Damned, X, Buzzcocks, Stiff Little Fingers, Glen Matlock and members of Sleater-Kinney with Fred Armisen.

events.title: The Love of Soul Tour: Fantasia, Anthony Hamilton, October London
events.summary: A major R&B/soul package tour brings Fantasia, Anthony Hamilton and October London to Hard Rock Live in nearby Hollywood, Florida.

events.title: Calema
events.summary: Lusophone Afropop duo Calema bring their São Tomé and Príncipe-rooted blend of African rhythms, Portuguese pop, Latin sounds and R&B to the Miami Beach Bandshell, presented by LPR.

events.title: Saint Levant – AFANDI World Tour
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Palestinian-Algerian artist Saint Levant brings the AFANDI World Tour to The Fillmore Miami Beach for a confirmed Friday-night show.
